source_text: Cell cultures was maintained at 37 °C in a humidified incubator with 5% CO2 [12]. The medium is replaced every 48 h and cells were passaged at 80% confluence. The absorbance was measured at wavelength of 450 nm using a microplate reader. Using ImageJ software, the images were analyzed to quantify colony formation. We did a bunch of tests to check whether the treatment worked. These results prove that the new protocol is perfect for all cell types. Due to the fact that the signal was weak at this point in time, the exposure time was increased to 30 s. The samples were heated to 95 °C for 10 min then cooled on ice. Statistical significance was set at p < 0.05, and representative images are shown in Fig. 2.
